seo.title: Join Our Network | Kasi Transport
seo.description: Drive for Kasi Transport or register your vehicles as a transport partner. Driver careers and transport partnerships with a Petaling Jaya logistics operation.

intro.title: Drive with us. Or bring your fleet.
intro.text: Kasi Transport grows with the people who move for it. Whether you drive for a living or run vehicles of your own, there is a place for you in our network.

drivers.title: Drive your career forward.
drivers.text: Join the company-operated fleet and drive with a team that plans schedules properly, assigns work clearly and follows up on every delivery.
look: A valid driving licence for the vehicle you drive
A safety-first approach on the road
Honesty and respect in dealing with customers and colleagues
Willingness to work to schedules, including overnight runs

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Send us your details using the form.

steps.title: We call you
steps.text: Our team contacts you to talk through your experience.

steps.title: Meet the team
steps.text: We discuss the roles available and what suits you.

steps.title: Start driving
steps.text: Join the fleet and get your first schedule.

form.title: Driver application
form.note: Your application opens in WhatsApp or your email app, ready to send.

partners.title: Your fleet. More opportunities.
partners.text: Own a lorry or run a transport company? Join the Kasi transport network and work alongside our company-operated fleet.

who.title: Owner-drivers
who.text: You own the truck and drive it yourself.

who.title: Lorry owners
who.text: You own vehicles and have drivers to run them.

who.title: Small transport businesses
who.text: A growing operation looking for steadier work.

who.title: Fleet operators
who.text: A larger fleet ready for scheduled, recurring jobs.

gain: Opportunities across linehaul, commercial and event transport
Clear communication on schedules and requirements
A network that grows with the business

form.title: Partner registration
form.note: Your registration opens in WhatsApp or your email app, ready to send.
